title: Work IQ: memory profile path in Work IQ MCP for agents
notes: 2026-11-16: taken offline; the grace for pages published before the check existed is off
summary: Hold: the governance guidance overstates what administrators can discover and delete, and assumes memory-access audit records are available without documentation. The Graph automation entry is not a callable request, the memory controls need more precise qualifications, and the cost rating assumes metering that the page itself says is unknown.

claims.claim: The consent scope granting access to the memory path is unpublished.

claims.claim: Work IQ retrieve requires Copilot Credits billing.
claims.quote: Set up usage-based billing for Copilot Credits and assign the calling users to a spending policy that includes Work IQ API.
claims.fix: Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/work-iq/mcp/retrieve and identify retrieve as public preview; retain the distinction from the undocumented memory path.

claims.claim: Whether the memory path follows retrieve billing, and its specific metering, is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ memory coreMemories licensing Copilot Credits retrieve billing. Opened API overview and read retrieve and Work IQ pricing excerpts; none describes memory-path metering.

claims.claim: No admin-centre UI is documented for the tenant Enhanced personalization control.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot enhanced personalization tenant admin center turn off memory enhancedPersonalizationSetting. Opened Manage Copilot personalization and memory, Enhanced personalization control overview and Configure Microsoft Copilot settings; only Graph configuration is documented.

claims.claim: enhancedPersonalizationSetting resource (Microsoft Graph) is the automation call for the tenant control.
claims.quote: Searched: enhancedPersonalizationSetting via the cited resource's Update link. Opened resource and Update references; they document a resource type and a PATCH request, not the printed string as a callable request.
claims.fix: Replace the resource-name placeholder with 'PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/settings/people/enhancedpersonalization' and the required body property isEnabledInOrganization (false to disable). Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/enhancedpersonalizationsetting-update?view=graph-rest-beta; flag beta, PeopleSettings.ReadWrite.All and the People Administrator requirement for delegated access.

claims.claim: Enhanced personalization is on by default.
claims.quote: By default, Enhanced personalization is turned on.
claims.fix: Identify Copilot personalization and memory as preview, subject to change, in the control note or adjacent prose. Keep its default separate from the unknown default of the new memory path.

claims.claim: Turning off Enhanced personalization disables custom instructions for users.
claims.quote: End-users that have the Enhanced personalization control turned off see the user-level controls for Custom instructions, Saved memories, and Chat history in Settings > Personalization as turned off. They can't turn on these settings.

claims.claim: Turning off Enhanced personalization disables saved memories for users.
claims.quote: End-users that have the Enhanced personalization control turned off see the user-level controls for Custom instructions, Saved memories, and Chat history in Settings > Personalization as turned off. They can't turn on these settings.

claims.claim: Turning off Enhanced personalization disables chat-history details for users.
claims.quote: End-users that have the Enhanced personalization control turned off see the user-level controls for Custom instructions, Saved memories, and Chat history in Settings > Personalization as turned off. They can't turn on these settings.

claims.claim: The maker path for agent memory is Build > Memory toggle.
claims.quote:
1. Create or open the agent in Copilot Studio.
2. Select the Build tab.
3. In the components panel, use the Memory toggle to turn the feature on or off.
claims.fix: Use 'agent > Build > components panel > Memory toggle' in the front matter and rendered table. The current path omits the intervening components panel; also identify this as the Microsoft Copilot harness preview.

claims.claim: No API equivalent of the Copilot Studio Microsoft Copilot harness Memory toggle is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio Microsoft Copilot harness memory enable disable API PowerShell; "Copilot Studio" "memory" "API" "toggle". Opened Memory overview and read returned memory and API results; no toggle API.

claims.claim: The maker turns agent memory on or off.
claims.quote: As the maker, you turn Memory on or off for each agent.

claims.claim: Memories for a Copilot Studio agent are deleted after 28 days without interaction.
claims.quote: Customer Conversation harness memory captures structured context through a defined schema of built-in and custom parameters, and covers short-term conversation context only, with a retention period of 30 days.
claims.fix: Restrict the row to 'Memory on or off for a Copilot Studio agent using the Microsoft Copilot harness (preview)'. State 'If a user does not interact with that agent for 28 days, their memories from that agent are deleted.' The cited memory-overview supports that narrower claim; other harnesses have different retention.

claims.claim: Turning agent Memory off does not delete stored memories.
claims.quote: Turning Memory off doesn't delete stored memories. It only prevents the agent from using them.

claims.claim: Tenant Work IQ MCP policy can be turned on or off through Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Tools > Work IQ MCP > Policy.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation, select Agents > Tools.
In the tools registry, select Work IQ MCP.
On the Work IQ MCP details pane, select the Policy tab when it's available.

claims.claim: No automation call for the tenant Work IQ MCP policy toggle is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ MCP policy configuration API Graph PowerShell tenant policy settings. Opened Policy governance for Work IQ MCP and read returned API and provisioning results; no policy-toggle endpoint or command.

claims.claim: No dedicated UI or API control over the memory profile path is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ MCP /memory/me/coreMemories permissions memory policy default licensing audit; Work IQ coreMemories memory control personalization enable default. Opened MCP policy, API overview and permissions; no memory-specific control.

claims.claim: Purview retention policies do not apply to Copilot memory.
claims.quote: Retention policies and retention labels configured in Purview by organization admins don't apply to Copilot memory.

claims.claim: Administrators cannot restrict what information is remembered by Copilot memory.
claims.quote: No, admins can't restrict what type of information is added to Copilot memory.

claims.claim: eDiscovery can find and delete Copilot memory without qualification.
claims.quote: Custom instructions aren't yet discoverable in these solutions. An admin can also delete memory data through Microsoft Graph Explorer in combination with Purview.
claims.fix: Replace 'eDiscovery can find and delete it' with 'Saved memories and inferred chat-history memories are discoverable using eDiscovery and Microsoft Graph Explorer; custom instructions are not. Admin deletion uses Microsoft Graph Explorer in combination with Purview.' Keep applicability to the new memory path explicitly unconfirmed.

claims.claim: How the new memory profile path interacts with Enhanced personalization or the Copilot Studio Memory toggle is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ coreMemories memory control personalization enable default. Opened Enhanced personalization control overview, Manage Copilot personalization and memory, Memory overview and Work IQ MCP policy; no mapping to /memory/me/coreMemories.

claims.claim: Administrators can review audit records of memory access.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" "memory" "audit" "coreMemories"; "Work IQ" memory access audit logs Purview. Read Work IQ logging excerpts and opened Manage Copilot personalization and memory; no reviewable memory-path audit event or location is documented.
claims.fix: Replace the instruction with 'Confirm whether memory-path access produces administrator-accessible audit records before relying on audit review.' Add that Copilot memory and personalization actions do not generate Purview audit entries, per https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/copilot-personalization-memory, while Work IQ documents general tool-invocation logging but no memory-specific audit workflow.

claims.claim: The feature has variable cost even though its metering is unknown.
claims.quote: cost: "variable"; 'whether the memory path follows it is unknown'; 'memory-specific metering is not yet published.'
claims.fix: Set cost to 'low' for the currently established review and communication effort, and change the rationale to 'Low. Privacy review and user communications require staff time; memory-path licensing and metering are not yet published.' Keep general Work IQ Copilot Credits billing as background, not proof of this path's meter.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist recommends restricting consent to approved agents but has no corresponding control row.
claims.quote: 'Restrict consent to approved agents.' The table contains Enhanced personalization, agent Memory, tenant Work IQ MCP policy and the undocumented memory-path control, but no consent control.
claims.fix: Add a row for application consent to Work IQ, clearly distinguished from unconfirmed memory-path scopes. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/work-iq/permissions for the broad delegated permissions and admin-consent requirement; research exact UI and automation before populating those sides. Alternatively make the checklist a request to establish the future consent model, rather than an instruction to set it.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist recommends memory-access audit review but the controls table has no audit row.
claims.quote: 'Review audit records of memory access.' No audit or monitoring control appears in the controls table.
claims.fix: After removing the unsupported audit-review instruction, add an explicitly undocumented memory-access audit surface row if the checklist still asks administrators to establish monitoring. Do not populate it with generic Purview controls as though they document memory-path events.
